description: Prestigious & fully renovated apartment of 280 sqm located on the 1st floor (with elevator) of a traditional and secured Haussmannien building.The spaceDiscover a unique apartment in a unique location ! With its 10 person capacity this property is totally capable of welcoming all your loved ones ! The apartment is actually the gathering of two apartments which communicate via a corridor. Former offices of Pierre Cardin, this prestigious address combines modern furnishing and french Haussmannien classicism. Composed of 5 bedroom (one room offers twin beds on request), 6 bathrooms, two separate toilets, two living area, two equipped kitchen, two washing machine and a 45sqm dinning area this place is ideal to fit all your colleagues or friends ! These 300sqm are designed to make you feel comfortable and allow everyone its private space !Air conditioning, heating and TV's are available in all bedrooms as in living areas. WIFI and high speed internet are also available throughout the apartment. As all our apartments are non smoker. The metro is running below the apartment and can be overheard from it.Please note that construction works will be going on from July 2024 until July 2026, they will be taking place in the building next door .Guest accessThe property is close to two metro stations: Madeleine & Concorde gathering four subway lines: Line 1, Line 8, Line 12 and Line 14. The nearest parkings are Concorde & Madeleine, less than 10 minutes away.Other things to noteThe metro is running below the apartment and can be overheard from it.Please note that construction works will be going on from July 2024 until July 2026, they will be taking place in the building next door .
